verdict.rationale: The only billing evidence is a monthly spend-limit control for metered usage beyond included credits. That is an adjacent control, not a published per-tool-call or per-connection price list, and no rate limits are documented anywhere in the pack. A community user also reports that the pricing page's credit system is unclear and that pay-as-you-go costs after plan limits are not visible, which confirms the gap.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
